def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,H,W=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:H]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==W and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    A=np.array(A); Hh,Ww=A.shape; msk=(A==8); y,x=np.where(msk)

for n in [1,2,3]:

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,H,W=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:H]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==W and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); T=np.array(G['Test input']); H,W=T.shape
# Check: is O the window at cols 27-29 unchanged (mirror image)? Compare with demos using map j->W-1-j directly:
for n,(a,c),srcpos in [(1,(7,26),(0)),(2,(2,21),(0)),(3,(14,25),(0))]:
    Ai=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); Ao=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    oh,ow=Ao.shape
    s=Ai[a:a+oh, W-1-(c+ow-1):W-1-c]
    print(n,'mirror(src) == O?',np.array_equal(s,Ao),'==fliplr(O)?',np.array_equal(np.fliplr(s),Ao))
# also try flipud
print('flipud check:', [np.array_equal(np.flipud(s),Ao) for _ in [0]])
